fee_notes: Royalty 3-10% of monthly Gross Volume, minimum $100/month. Fixed fee $45-$115/month. Advertising fee up to 3% monthly plus 2% annual Gross Volume (capped at $650,000, increasing $50k/year). Transfer fee up to $9,500. Renewal fee $500 ($1,000 if late). National Call Center fees $15-$50 per job lead. Additional fees for training, consulting, certification.
